title: Lego 3D Interactive Builder
tagline: Parametric brick assembly with grid-snapping physics and procedural shaders.
description: An interactive browser-based 3D workspace where users can assemble, snap, rotate, and color parametric Lego bricks in real time. Features accurate stud-to-tube collision meshes, instanced rendering for high brick counts, and studio HDRI lighting.
interactiveDetails: Raycasting cursor plane snapping, dynamic color picker palette, orbital camera controls with damping, and one-click physics collapse mode.
highlightMetricOrFeature: Instanced Mesh Rendering (> 5,000 bricks at steady 60 FPS)
